name: Kamiyama Haruka
source:
The main heroine of this series. A third-year high school student.
A magical girl who fights as a Magic Knight (Magia Ritter) in the Kaminoyama City district.
She is a childhood friend of the series’ protagonist, Mamoru Ichijou, and they are also in a romantic relationship.
She has a carefree and cheerful personality that makes her well-liked by everyone.
